newsitem.title: USA: Youth Services stake held by investor.
newsitem.headline: Youth Services stake held by investor.

text.p: New York investor Ronald Baron said Wednesday he held a 10 percent stake in Youth Services International Inc or 921,000 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Baron said his latest transactions include the purchase of 106,500 common shares between Oct 2 and Nov 21 at prices ranging from $10.875 to $17.125 per share.
Baron paid $11.2 million for the stock and holds the stake for investment purposes, the filing said.
Baron is the president of Baron Capital Management Inc, which is a New York based investment firm.
Youth Services is a Owings Mills, Md.,-based of juvenile correction facilities.
